QUOTE: When `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} ref={ref} />` (lines 128–135).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says NavigationHeader is a forwardRef component that passes its ref to NavigationSearch only when `hasSearch` is true. It doesn't say outright that the ref attaches to nothing otherwise, but the conditional rendering implies it.
